acceptedContract.acceptanceBoundary: Shared behavior only; it is not a public deployment, installed-client, SDK, or Wallet UI acceptance.

protocol.originPolicy: Only an exact canonical HTTPS origin present in the enabled product registry may authorize, complete, prove, introspect, or revoke a Product Session. Completion additionally requires the HTTP Origin to equal the signed authorization origin.
protocol.legacyRecovery: Persisted wallet-auth-v1 sessions remain readable for inventory and revocation after restart but are marked origin-binding-retired and return SESSION_RETIRED until a controlled reconnect issues a v2 session. No v1 proof can be created.
protocol.nonInference: No origin is derived from productId, bundleId, callback, URL scheme, or a local fallback.
